payload.friendly_name: Merge-seam placement, test-isolation sweep & model-slot verdict
payload.purpose_context: Grounding on current main confirmed three open tech-debt issues (#5119, #5118, #5117) are still real and do not collide with the in-flight ratchet mission's files. The merge domain duplicates a git blob-read helper and reaches up into the CLI adapter for merge-driver logic; 41 test sites mutate global state by hand and SonarCloud no longer watches that rule; and the agent-profile model slot looks inert to detectors although consumers author it. This mission consolidates those surfaces behind non-vacuous guards so the debt cannot silently regrow.
payload.purpose_tldr: Pay down three tech-debt findings: one canonical merge-driver/blob-read home in the merge domain, tests that stop leaking global state, and a recorded keep-verdict for the agent-profile model slot.

payload.question: How broad should the #5118 test-isolation sweep be: the 41 Sonar-cited sites only (freeze the rest of what the local detector finds as a shrink-only baseline), or everything the local detector finds (~430 raw hits / ~130 files, noisy)?

Sweep S8: remaining dirs incl. root conftest.py
Merge → CLI-command-layer rule and driver-body relocation (#5119)
Seal the manual global-state census allowlist (#5118)
Single raw git blob reader in the merge domain (#5119)
Golden characterisation of the six merge drivers (#5119)
Sweep S6: import hygiene in docs/architectural/release/scripts/ci/lint tests
